checks.detail: Candidate-owned Godot ERROR blocks remained after the final Tester runtime branch and log probe.

Default B roll, distinct I inventory, rebind persistence, default restoration, movement, jump/landing, sprint animation, Alt dodge, horizontal/pitch look, wheel distance clamps, shoulder switching, bow aim-distance recovery and inventory mouse isolation were observed. Distance clamps at 2.0–6.5 and pitch at -0.85–0.45; horizontal look spans a full turn. Automatic steps, wall sliding/stopping, obstruction and distance recovery, sprint-versus-walk speed, and complete attachment/orientation acceptance remain unverified. Scoped task success cannot establish the full review_r02 contract. Final runtime logs after the last input contain only three startup messages and no reported runtime error.

required_criteria.requirement:
Review the declared production milestone 基础空间与可玩切片。: **基础空间与可玩切片。** 先在 MAP01 的紧凑真实空间完成移动/镜头、伊莎求助、交剑、一次可胜利且可死亡恢复的训练实战；随后连接弓、旧灯、首次升级、主题化界面、暂停存档与重载，组成约 5–8 分钟的连续可玩切片。MAP02/MAP03 此时只核查候选素材、通路与战场容量，不以独立空地图作为本阶段交付；先验证角色动作、真实战斗、任务变化和保存能共同运作，再复制内容。
Require candidate-bound runtime evidence for this milestone; future milestones remain pending, and previously verified behavior must be preserved. This milestone review does not waive any final PRD requirement.

PRD R02: 移动、跳跃、冲刺、闪避、自动上阶有效；鼠标可水平环视和上下俯仰，滚轮平滑拉近/拉远并遵守限位与遮挡，瞄准退出恢复自由距离，菜单滚动不操纵镜头；朝向、手持、背挂和切肩正确
Bind candidate runtime evidence to scenario(s): review_r02. This is a required product acceptance review, not an executable test or a passed observation.

developer_outcome.summary: Fresh recovery confirms runnable roll with native displacement, explicit frames and clean logs. Preserved inventory/rebind/restart checks passed. Tracker returned-position discrepancy and independent full R02/32-cell acceptance remain unresolved. Cited receipts establish boundary resource identity, not whole-source attestation.

risk_note.summary: A correct key-map readout can still conceal an intercepted event; numeric tracker geometry can still be paired with a menu screenshot.
risk_note.validation: Observe roll motion and inventory visibility through ordinary input, then restart/rebind. Correlate settled gameplay frames with read-only tracker state, especially 1920×1080 short/200%/expanded.
risk_note.why_now: Both issues are Host-pinned, and repeated tracker evidence failure requires a different strategy while the major roll defect blocks usable traversal.

task_requirements.requirement: With default controls in ordinary grounded gameplay, B visibly executes the existing roll without opening inventory; I opens/closes inventory, and affected prompts show the actual distinct controls.
An accepted roll rebind works and survives restart; binding it to reserved inventory I is rejected without changing the effective binding, and restoring defaults returns roll to B.
